# Boris Dračka — CFO Unfiltered

> Personal site of Boris Dračka, a CFO with 30 years of experience, testing what happens when AI enters the finance department: practical experiments in reporting, forecasting, controls and CFO decision-making.

The site is a personal, non-commercial project. Content is available in English and Slovak.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://borisdracka.com/): who Boris is and what the site covers
- [Blog](https://borisdracka.com/blog): "The CFO & AI Series" — posts with practical AI experiments for finance leaders
- [Agents](https://borisdracka.com/agents): the library of AI agent examples referenced in the blog
- [Slovenská verzia](https://borisdracka.com/sk/): Slovak version of the site
